questions.question: What kind of fasting does God reject in Isaiah 58?
options: Fasting while quarreling and oppressing workers
Fasting on the wrong day of the week
Fasting in private without telling anyone at all
questions.answer: Fasting while quarreling and oppressing workers

questions.question: What is the fast God chooses, according to Isaiah 58?
options: To loose the bonds of wickedness, share bread with the hungry, and house the poor
To recite very long and very solemn prayers aloud out in the public square
To put on the rough sackcloth and to sit down in the ashes for many days and nights
To bring greater and far more costly offerings to the holy temple of the LORD
questions.answer: To loose the bonds of wickedness, share bread with the hungry, and house the poor

questions.question: Isaiah 58 promises that honoring the Sabbath and delighting in the LORD brings blessing.
Is not this the fast that I choose: to loose the bonds of _____?
Share your bread with the hungry, and bring the poor and homeless into your _____.
